theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_inf_valuation_fraction_characterization
theorems.statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (s : F), Transcendental K s → (∀ f : F, ∃ a b : Polynomial K, b ≠ 0 ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval s a / Polynomial.aeval s b) → ∀ w : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F, s⁻¹ ∉ w.toValuationSubring → ∀ f : F, f ∈ w.toValuationSubring ↔ ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ (Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ∣ b ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval s a / Polynomial.aeval s b
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the accepted polynomial-unit criterion and exponent bound to characterize membership by fractions whose denominator is not divisible by X.
